parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name. To obtain the domain name, call [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains).

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

The default value is **zh**.
